brief.title: Egypt, *under your name.*
brief.subtitle: Template preview of the Travel & Concierge master: how NOYA delivers Egypt for a partner's clients.
brief.lead: When a client asks for Egypt, you keep the client, the booking and the relationship. NOYA designs and delivers the Egypt side to your standard, under your name or co-branded.
brief.roles_note: Your client deals with you. NOYA works behind you, with one lead and a 24-hour line during travel.
